metric_formulas.mouse_pearson: population Pearson correlation over per-bin raw mouse deltas; NA when either axis series has zero variance or fewer than two bins
metric_formulas.mouse_scale_ratio: unsigned population-standard-deviation ratio max(std_gt,std_pred)/min(std_gt,std_pred), reported >=1 when defined and NA for zero/near-zero scale
metric_formulas.mouse_button_accuracy: per-bin exact count-multiset match for left/right/middle down/up mouse-button events
metric_formulas.keyboard_key_accuracy: per-bin exact count-multiset match by key and keyboard event type

notes: Local D2E-style fixture evaluator is dependency-light; headline real-D2E runs should invoke pinned official D2E evaluate.py or record deviations.
